python_reference_model.role: local reproducible inference and VQA-style evaluation

static_space_model.implementation: Hugging Face official SmolVLM WebGPU processing and generation pattern
reliability_notes: The app checks for a WebGPU adapter before loading the model.
Image inputs are converted to data URLs and loaded with the Transformers.js load_image helper.
The processor chat template and AutoModelForVision2Seq class match the official browser example.
Failed model workers are reset so the user can retry without reloading the page.

note: Do not publish numerical metrics until scripts/evaluate_vqa.py has been run on a documented dataset.
